name: Walnut Park (Arkansas City)
note: City of Arkansas City river park on the west bank of the Walnut River off E. Madison Ave just east of US-77, with a boat ramp: a gravel loop with no marked sites. The city's current parks list gives 216 W. Birch Ave, which is a town block 1.6 km north; its 2021 park page gave 1100 E. Madison Ave. Pad size is unknown: the city gives no length, but the loop is wide gravel. No dump station here (use Newman Park's). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Arkansas City Comprehensive Fee Schedule (eff. 2026-01-01, read 2026-11-06): 'VI. Camping (Camping Permit Valid for 72 Hours) (5 day maximum) A. Walnut Park ... $10.00/Day'; city Parks Listing (read 2026-11-06): 'Walnut Park ... Amenities: Camping, fishing, picnic tables'; city park page (Wayback 2021-11-19): 'Boat Ramp, Camping, Fishing, Picnic Tables, Rest Rooms', 1100 E. Madison Ave; Esri imagery 2025-05-31 shows a drive-in gravel loop off Madison Ave; Campendium 12/2024 visitor (25-ft travel trailer) describes it as 'mostly level' with a $10 rate -> current city RV camping area (public presence ladder step 1; no price gate). Different place from 2202 Newman Park (2.2 km SW, own entrance off W. Lincoln Ave).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-06: Esri World Imagery 2025-05-31 (220 m and 600 m frames at 37.0575,-97.0262, rendered) plus Wayback leaf-off 2018-04-05 and 2021-11-12 (z18, rendered): the gravel loop's east leg is 25-45 m from the Walnut River behind a continuous riverbank tree band (dense leaf-on, sparse leaf-off); south of the loop an open lawn runs to the boat-ramp lane, which runs along the bank between the lawn and the water. The city marks no sites and no frame shows a camped rig, so it is not confirmed that any RV camping spot overlooks the river: unsure, so down to not waterfront (riverview possible if campers use the loop's east leg or the ramp-side lawn). Not a reservoir; no dam berm in play.

fees.note: City fee schedule effective January 1, 2026: $10 a day. A camping permit is valid for 72 hours.

fees_source: https://www.arkcity.org/DocumentCenter/View/211/Comprehensive-Fee-Schedule---Jan-2026-Update ('VI. Camping (Camping Permit Valid for 72 Hours) (5 day maximum) A. Walnut Park ... $10.00/Day'), read 2026-11-06; Campendium 'Last nightly rate $10 (reported 12/1/24)'

booking.note: City fee schedule: 'Camping Permit Valid for 72 Hours (5 day maximum)'. The city's pages don't say where the permit is bought; a November 2024 camper at Newman Park, on the same terms, was sent to City Hall (no pay box).

booking_source: https://www.arkcity.org/DocumentCenter/View/211/Comprehensive-Fee-Schedule---Jan-2026-Update (Camping: '(Camping Permit Valid for 72 Hours) (5 day maximum)'), read 2026-11-06; Campendium Newman Park review 2024-11-21: 'There is no pay box, so you must go to City Hall to register.'
rvlife: 0*/$ (park 265965, park_type city; unrated, no reviews, and a $ with no avg_rate is RV Life's default, not a tier; read 2026-11-06)
flags: fees: $10/day -- city Comprehensive Fee Schedule Jan 2026 (above). Copied the shape of 2202 Newman Park.

booking: 72-hour permit, 5-day maximum -- same fee schedule; max_stay_nights 5 as on 2202. Where the permit is sold is unconfirmed (AllStays, undated: 'Must go to City Utilities Building to pay and get permit'; Campendium's Newman Park camper 11/2024: City Hall). Not reservable online; no reservation channel found.

facilities: rest rooms + boat ramp + picnic tables -- city park page (Wayback 2021-11-19 'Boat Ramp, Camping, Fishing, Picnic Tables, Rest Rooms'); a Dyrt visitor (Aug 2023, day use) confirms a bathroom ('terribly stinky bathroom', 'No electric outlets. No showers.'). Toilet type unknown, so no flush/vault value. No showers (same Dyrt visitor). No dump station on site (Campendium 12/2024: 'No dump station, you have to go to Newman Park'). Potable water: Campendium/AllStays list water, unconfirmed by the city -- not stamped.

hookups: UNKNOWN -- conflicting, nothing authoritative. rvparking.com (undated, tip from 2011) says '16 sites', 'Power: 30 Amps, 15 Amps'; The Dyrt visitor Aug 2023: 'No electric outlets'; the city lists no hookups. Satellite can't show pedestals. Leave hookups absent.

sites: no marked sites (unmarked gravel loop); site count unknown -- rvparking's '16' is undated aggregator data, unused. Max rig: none published; Campendium's 'longest vehicle 25 ft' is the visiting reviewer's own 25-ft travel trailer and he did not stay overnight -- note-line caveat only, not max_rig_ft. Pad size unclear -> kept with caveat (AWH 2026-11-02).

address conflict: the city's current Parks Listing gives '216 W. Birch Ave.' (geocodes to 37.0710,-97.0407, an open town block in a residential grid, no water, no fishing possible); the city's own 2021 park page, Campendium, The Dyrt, AllStays, Google Maps ('Walnut City Park', 37.0570,-97.0262, 4.5 from 2 reviews, no phone) and RV Life all put Walnut Park at the river at E. Madison Ave. Pinned at the river loop. rvparking.com gives 1400 E. Madison.

currently-operating evidence is the January 2026 fee schedule listing camping at Walnut Park; no dated review of an overnight stay was found (the Campendium 12/2024 reviewer stayed at Newman Park and only visited; The Dyrt 2023 reviewer did not stay overnight).
waterfront: went DOWN to not waterfront for want of known camping spots; riverview is plausible (loop east leg 25-45 m from the river through a tree band; open lawn to the boat-ramp lane).
floodplain: the park sits on the Walnut River bank below US-77/Madison Ave grade -- likely to flood in high water (not stated by the city).

duplicate check: no DB entry within ~2 km; 2202 Newman Park (37.04183,-97.04052) is 2.2 km SW with its own entrance off W. Lincoln Ave. Phone and website are the same as 2202 (Parks and Facilities Division).
